record.question: Which of the following best describes a flat panel detector (FPD)?
options: An image receptor that requires a separate cassette and reader.
A device that uses a vacuum tube to convert X-rays into a visible image.
A solid-state detector that directly or indirectly converts X-rays into an electrical signal.
A digital imaging system that relies on a CCD camera to capture an image.
record.explanation: Answer C: A solid-state detector that directly or indirectly converts X-rays into an electrical signal.. An FPD is a solid-state digital detector converting X-ray energy to an electrical signal directly or via a scintillator. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/mammo; https://www.dicomstandard.org/current. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
